name: patchmon-helm
description: Build and publish wrapper for the PatchMon Helm chart. The chart itself lives in the repository root; this directory holds only the npm scripts the GitHub workflows drive, so the lint, package and push logic is defined once.

scripts.publish: sh -c 'helm push dist/$0 "${CHART_REGISTRY:?set CHART_REGISTRY, e.g. oci://ghcr.io/<owner>/charts}"'
